Date: Thu, 16 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Flight coverage & handback plan for Redwood–SableTech onsite (finalize itineraries)

Team / Aleron —

We need a final pass on flight coverage and the handback plan for the Redwood–SableTech executive workshop on Aug 28–29. Key constraints:
- SableTech execs (Morgan + 2) need arrivals by 2pm PDT on 8/28.
- Redwood leadership (Ben + Karthik) prefer to land no later than 5pm PDT to join the pre-meeting sync.
- Minimize connections for SableTech (one-stop max).

Aleron: attached is the most recent workbook with PNR placeholders (redwood_sabletech_itineraries_v3.xlsx). Please send updated PNR PDFs and a single consolidated itinerary per traveler. Include any seat/meal requests and baggage allowances. If you hit availability issues, propose the two best fallback options and note delta in travel time and layover.

Ben/Marissa/Karthik: can you confirm any hard constraints (redeye preferred/avoid, status upgrades allowed) now so we can lock the booking by EOD tomorrow? Also confirm if we should use company card or submit for pre-approval via Concur (link below).

Concur pre-approval: https://concur.com/expense/approvals/RED-4521

Thanks — Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Program Manager, Onsite Ops | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0176

From: Aleron Travel <travel@aleron.com>

Hi Hannah —

Thanks for the brief. We reviewed availability and built three candidate itineraries per traveler. Summary:
- Morgan Ellis (SableTech): best option (one stop, arrive SFO 13:05 PDT on 8/28, total travel 5h10m, connection at SEA).
- SableTech guest A: nonstop into SFO arrives 12:40 PDT (higher fare, limited seats).
- Redwood: Ben — red-eye to arrive morning options but we prioritized arrival before 17:00; best fits land SFO 15:55 PDT on 8/28 with 1 stop. Karthik — nonstop red-eye arrives 10:20 PDT on 8/28 (preferred).

Attachments: PNR-ALR12345.pdf (Morgan Ellis PNR) and a consolidated workbook saved as redwood_sabletech_itineraries_v3.xlsx (sheet named "Aleron options").

Action items:
1) Please confirm which option to ticket for each traveler by 8/17 18:00 PDT.
2) If you want to apply status upgrades or seat changes, supply frequent flyer numbers.
3) Confirm payment path (company card or employee reimbursement).

If needed, we can hold fares for 24 hours for a small fee.

Best,
Rita Alvarez
Senior Account Manager — Aleron Travel
travel@aleron.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Flight coverage & handback plan for Redwood–SableTech onsite (finalize itineraries)

Hannah / Rita —

I can do the 15:55 arrival (one stop) — fine with the connection. No seat upgrade necessary. Company card is fine for me.

Marissa — can you confirm hotel check-in logistics and whether we should request early check-in for Ben? We're hosting the welcome drinks at 6:00pm so he should be at the hotel no later than 5:00pm.

Thanks,
Ben

- Ben Carter: one-stop ticketed, arrives SFO 15:55 PDT 8/28, PNR ALR12347.
